player_prompt.intro:
Umekuwa uanachama wa Mastermind.
Unahitaji kupata msimbo ambao ni {code_length} tarakimu kwa urefu, kila tarakimu kutoka 1 hadi {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Katika jibu lako, unaweza kuwasilisha dhana yako kwa muundo ufuatao: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Baada ya kila dhana, utapokea mawaido kwa umbo la pegi nyeusi na nyeupe.
Pegi nyeusi inaonyesha tarakimu sahihi katika nafasi sahihi, wakati pegi nyeupe inaonyesha tarakimu sahihi katika nafasi isiyo sahihi.
Una {max_turns} mizunguko kupiga msimbo.
player_prompt.with_repeats: no kũhoteke gũcokererũo nĩ ũndũ ũcio rĩngĩ
player_prompt.no_duplicates: hatarĩ icunjĩ cia ũhoro ũcio rĩngĩ

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ndwarĩ na namba cia marandĩkĩre iria ciatigĩtwo tũthũngũri.
invalid_move.not_integers: Maũndũ mothe marĩa mandĩkĩtwo no mũhaka makorũo marĩ namba njĩru.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Ũhoro ũcio wagĩrĩirũo gũkorũo na namba {code_length}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Namba ciothe no mũhaka ikorũo irĩ gatagatĩ ka 1 na {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Nĩ ũhĩtĩte {guess}. Reke wĩgerie ũndũ ũngĩ ngũrani na ũcio.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: Umevunja msimbo, ukishinda {black_pegs} kati ya {code_length} pegi kwa usahihi
outcome.turn_limit: Ũtaũri wa ũgarũrũku nĩ ũkinyĩte. Waguire {percent} gĩcunjĩ kĩa namba ũrĩa wagĩrĩire.
